_README: yap-1107-parity-news — every state the approved Yappy News page (design-2026-11-06/news.html) DRAWS for the built surfaces, measured by scripts/parity-sheet.mjs (one MEASURE function on both sides). Numbers in expect are read off the page's own CSS (news.html <style> + assets/review.css). Sizes in logical CSS px, colours exact hex. States the page describes but does not draw are listed under notDrawn, with why, instead of being guessed. Home states click '?[data-news-duo-skip]' (optional: only while the joint delivery plays) so the card is measured in the page's settled state, both lines in the bubble and the three stories.

states.note: §01 onboarding step 'Want me to keep you posted?': step line, Yappy 72 px + heading 26 px + lede 13 px, chips, two fields, privacy line. .ob .body padding 28/36/24, gap 18.

§01 .row: grid 72px 1fr, gap 14; Yappy canvas 72x72 at a whole-number scale; h3 26px; lede 13px #56534d. Measured on the page: 688 x 76.17 (lede two lines at 13 px x 1.55; the app breaks it at 38em so SF wraps like Plex).
§01 .chips: ten chips, 34 px tall, padding 0 14, radius 17, 14 px; selected #1d1c1a on #fff text; gap 8.
§01 first .field: 38 px tall, radius 10, padding 0 12, gap 8, 14 px label #8b877f, ticker tokens 12 px mono on #efeee9.
§01 .obfoot: Not now left, Keep me posted right; padding 14/36; #f3f2ee; buttons 36 px, radius 10, 14 px.

§02 .bcard on Home: white card, radius 12, padding 14, gap 12; header (pair | speech bubble | time), three stories in a row, topic chips + cadence line. The page draws an 880 px window with a 208 px sidebar, which gives the card 640 px (610 inside). The app shell is 220 px + the 24 px .content padding a side, and below 900 px it switches to the 56 px icon rail (sidebarRail.ts RAIL_AUTO_BELOW_PX, spec 1.1): at 880 the card measured 776 (746 inside) — the batch-2 bounce. So Home is measured at 908 wide, where the full sidebar shows and the card gets the page’s 640 (908 - 220 - 48). OPEN for parity-home / Wilson: sidebar 208 vs 220 and the 900 px rail threshold.

§02 .bhead: grid max-content 1fr max-content, gap 14; Cinder + Yappy drawn as ONE 104x44 art canvas shown at 208x88 (NewsBriefing.tsx paintDuo, Yappy at 2,6, Cinder at 54,2, the paper at 44,30); bubble #fffdf7, 13 px, padding 8/11, radius 10. Measured on the page: 610 x 98.56, sprite 208x88. Batch-1 bounce fixed (2026-11-08): the time column carries the page's amber .q tag (NewsBriefing.tsx paperLabel 'morning paper'/'evening paper', 500 11px mono #a06a00 on #fff4d6, both 13 characters, clock in 8 monospace cells), the bubble is ONE paragraph at line-height 1.55, and the sr-only title inherits the bubble's 13 px, so the header measures 610 x 98.56 with fonts [11, 12, 13] and the page's exact colour set (mock of the app CSS through scripts/parity-crops.mjs on this Mac: 610 x 98.56, colours identical).
§02 first .story: #fdfbf6, radius 10, padding 10, gap 6; tag 10 px mono #b93a26; headline 13 px/1.35 500; line 12 px/1.4 #56534d; source 10 px mono #8b877f.

§02 .bchips: 'Your topics' 12 px mono, chips 26 px tall, 12 px, padding 0 11, radius 13, on = #1d1c1a; '+ Add' plain; cadence line + Hide for today right; gap 6. Measured on the page: 610 x 50.59 (chips on line one, the cadence line wraps to line two at 12 px x 1.55).

notDrawn.why: OPEN QUESTION FOR WILSON. The item text says the News page draws the briefing in the isometric room while Companions/Decisions chose C, the layered side view. The page as it stands (2026-11-06T17:55Z redraw) draws Home with SIDE.attach (the layered side view), not iso.js, so the only crop the page offers is the side view and that is what is built and measured (s02-*). No isometric crop exists on the page to put in the sheet.

§03 is a table of WHEN refreshes happen (approved), not a drawing of the Settings control, so there is no artifact box to measure. Settings → Yappy News → How often stays as built by yap-1106-news-refresh-setting; its wording is checked against §03 by refreshSetting.test.tsx.
The page names the quote feed (§06 'a free quote feed with a key') but draws no key field. The field stays as built by yap-1106-fb-14-news-quote-key.
A table of example lines per voice, not a UI state; covered by the explain tests (yap-1106-news-explain).
